item.title: Cut and paste
item.description: Sorry if this is a really basic question. I'm learning r and often make mistakes in my very rudimentary code. I want to correct it, so I cut and paste the code I just ran so I can fix the error. The problem is it won't cut and paste in a way that will run even when the errors are fixed. Is there a way to cut and paste?
